change_scope: Only reproduction sufficiency instructions in section 3 of the skill. No helper, hint, linking, labelling, workflow, permission or original result changes.
case_design: 18 fresh Q2 historical inputs: 6 per month April/May/June, random.Random(4672027), excluding all earlier case inputs. 12 separately reported fresh constructed reproduction boundary/guard controls, independently annotated and reviewed before execution.
execution: 120 first decisions using fresh Codex subagents without parent history; anonymous arms and paired order; ten cases per session, no session sees both arms. Unchanged local recorder and frozen original scorer. Exact inherited backend identifier unavailable.
decision_rule: All 120 first decisions must be valid, with required checks and label/comment validation recorded before each decision.
Candidate constructed mean weighted error cost AND missed required reproduction actions must each be strictly lower in both repetitions.
Every candidate constructed reproduction decision must be correct: required label and kind both present, neither present when forbidden.
Candidate historical mean weighted error cost must not increase, full-case passes must not decrease and required-action omissions must not increase in either repetition.
No candidate unwanted reproduction action, safety failure, invalid final proposal, label-limit violation, security combination violation or repeated/reporter reference in any case.
Candidate constructed full-case passes must not decrease. All designated positive link/component controls must pass and retain their specified actions in both repetitions.
Candidate unsupported-reference count must not increase in either repetition.
primary_endpoint_reason: This is a narrow incomplete-code diagnosis. Fresh constructed boundaries directly test missed reproduction requests and over-requesting; random historical cases separately test regressions. This deliberately differs from the previous broad linking/label experiment and is declared before new execution. A control-only gain is not evidence of improved population accuracy.
analysis: Use unchanged frozen score_run for both cohorts separately. Report all per-case changes, reproduction omissions and unwanted requests, coverage and gates. Two correlated repetitions, AI-authored/AI-reviewed annotations; no significance, deployment acceptance, baseline-rule superiority or hosted-Claude performance claim.
preservation: Keep prior golden and conservative-linking inputs, expectations, first outputs and reports intact. Freeze all new policies, expectations and protocol before execution; no retuning, redraws or replacement first decisions to seek a win.
cost: Existing Codex assistant access only. No Anthropic/provider API calls, paid hosted evaluations, workflow dispatches, bought credits or external triage writes. Exact existing assistant metered usage unavailable.
known_regression_check: Separately record one candidate first decision on previously observed e51957. It must contain blocked/need-repro and need-repro and satisfy the original preserved expectation before adoption. This known case is excluded from all fresh-cohort metrics and is an additional adoption prerequisite, not evidence of generalization. No adaptive retry.
